items.headline: FDA approves first immunotherapy for stage three colon cancer after surgery
items.summary: The FDA approved Tecentriq, made by Roche, as a follow-up treatment after surgery for adults and children with a form of stage three colon cancer that responds well to immune therapy. In a large trial, adding the drug to standard chemotherapy cut the three year risk of the cancer coming back or causing death by about half, giving doctors their first checkpoint inhibitor option for this use.
items.why_it_matters: It is the first immune therapy shown to reduce recurrence after surgery for this common early-stage cancer, a meaningful advance for a large group of patients.
